description: This file defines implicit helper classes for working with Spark SQL DataSource V2 API, including conversions and type checks for tables, columns, options, and partition specifications.

classes.name: DataSourceV2Implicits
classes.description: Object containing implicit classes for enhancing Spark DataSource V2 API usability.

methods.name: TableHelper.asReadable
methods.description: Converts a Table to a SupportsRead, throws error if not supported.

methods.name: TableHelper.asWritable
methods.description: Converts a Table to SupportsWrite, throws error if not supported.

methods.name: TableHelper.asDeletable
methods.description: Converts a Table to SupportsDeleteV2, throws error if not supported.

methods.name: TableHelper.asTruncatable
methods.description: Converts a Table to TruncatableTable, throws error if not supported.

methods.name: TableHelper.supportsPartitions
methods.description: Checks if a Table supports partition management.

methods.name: TableHelper.asPartitionable
methods.description: Converts a Table to SupportsPartitionManagement, throws error if not supported.

methods.name: TableHelper.asAtomicPartitionable
methods.description: Converts a Table to SupportsAtomicPartitionManagement, throws error if not supported.

methods.name: TableHelper.asRowLevelOperationTable
methods.description: Converts a Table to RowLevelOperationTable, throws error if not supported.

methods.name: TableHelper.supports
methods.description: Checks if a Table supports a specific capability.

methods.name: TableHelper.supportsAny
methods.description: Checks if a Table supports any of the given capabilities.

methods.name: MetadataColumnsHelper.asStruct
methods.description: Converts an array of MetadataColumn to StructType.

methods.name: MetadataColumnsHelper.toAttributes
methods.description: Converts MetadataColumns to a sequence of AttributeReference.

methods.name: OptionsHelper.asOptions
methods.description: Converts a Map of options to a CaseInsensitiveStringMap.

methods.name: PartitionSpecsHelper.asUnresolvedPartitionSpecs
methods.description: Converts a sequence of PartitionSpec to UnresolvedPartitionSpec.

methods.name: PartitionSpecsHelper.asResolvedPartitionSpecs
methods.description: Converts a sequence of PartitionSpec to ResolvedPartitionSpec.
